title: guerrecontre-révolutionnaire circulatingviolence: as the intellectual foundation of modern torture
core_idea: Examine how the French conception of guerre contre-révolutionnaire operated as a military-intellectual framework that promoted torture as a method of information extraction and intimidation, and trace the historical circulation of associated techniques and knowledge from colonial Indochina through Algeria and Cold War networks to South America and U.S. counterinsurgency practice.
tldr: Comparative historical analysis tracing the intellectual and transnational circulation of torture techniques linked to French counter-revolutionary doctrine across colonial, Cold War, and transcontinental settings.
